description: Floodwater Depth in Saint-Louis and Matam Regions, Senegal as of 23 October 2024 is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Important note: This map is prepared with a 30-m VIIRS satellite-derived Floodwater Depth product. Coverage: Senegal. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
